intro: The Hollywood Hills rise above Hollywood and West Hollywood along Mulholland Drive and the Laurel and Cahuenga canyons, with music history in Laurel Canyon, a hillside amphitheater and some of the best Hollywood Sign views in town.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: The 1929 Laurel Canyon market linked to the area's 1960s music scene, with a deli counter and a small terrace.
places.o: A deli sandwich on the terrace and a look at the photos on the walls.

places.w: A cozy, romantic Italian restaurant tucked below the Canyon Country Store.
An intimate 1,200-seat outdoor amphitheater built into the hillside, across the freeway from the Hollywood Bowl.
places.o: Bring your own food and drinks for a summer show.

places.w: A short, easy walk to the cave used as the Batcave in the 1960s TV show, with a clear view of the Hollywood Sign.
places.o: Go early for parking, then keep going on the Brush Canyon trail.

places.w: A big off-leash dog park in a wooded hollow, with a separate area for small dogs.
places.o: Take the entrance curve slowly; it's steep.
